## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or missing capability? Please describe clearly. (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*)

## Proposed Solution / Design
Describe the solution and architecture you would like to see. How should this integrate with `mos-core`, `mos-orchestrator`, `mos-edge`, `mos-builder`, or `mos-cli`?

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, or links to relevant specifications or RFCs here.
